Roll Guile to pull a small unattended, held or unsecured object toward you from up to 6 squares away.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One visible Bulk 0 or 1 object within 6 squares that is unattended, held in one hand, or unsecured in a pocket or pouch.
Equipment / acquisition
A free hand to catch the object.
Type
Magic / Utility / Control

Make a Guile theft attack and draw the object toward you along an open path.

Weak
Move it up to 2 squares.
Standard
Move it up to 4 squares.
Strong
Move it up to 6 squares.

The object leaves its holder's hand or pocket when moved. Catch it if it reaches your free hand; otherwise place it in the last square reached.
